extracted.intended_audience: authors seeking representation / writers querying literary agents
extracted.subtask_description: Submission guidelines for authors querying Gelfman Schneider Literary Agents: what materials are accepted, how to submit, what is disallowed, and how to follow up. Includes agent-specific status and contact protocol.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow submission instructions exactly
rubrics_metrics.description: Please read all the instructions thoroughly, as any queries that do not follow these guidelines are deleted unread.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page repeatedly warns that queries failing to follow the guidelines will be deleted unread; applicants should read the full instructions and the FAQ before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not call the offices about a submission
rubrics_metrics.description: PLEASE DO NOT CALL THE OFFICES ABOUT A SUBMISSION. None of our agents accept queries or pitches via phone call.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phone inquiries about submissions are explicitly forbidden; do not attempt to contact agents by phone to pitch or query unless a submission process specifically requests it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check agent availability / respect closed status
rubrics_metrics.description: Several agents (Deborah Schneider, Jane Gelfman, Heather Mitchell, Penelope Burns) are currently closed to queries and will re-open at a later date; check the website for updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send queries to agents who are listed as closed. Deborah Schneider accepts queries only via referral while closed. Monitor the agency website for reopening announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not send unsolicited materials
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not accept unsolicited material. Please do not send any materials unless we have specifically requested them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any unsolicited manuscripts, bound galleys, or self-published editions will be discarded unread.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not include attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Any queries with attachments will be deleted unread.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency will delete queries that include attachments; do not attempt to send manuscript files, attachments, or files of any kind unless explicitly requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: No spam or repeat queries
rubrics_metrics.description: WE DO NOT ACCEPT SPAM or REPEAT QUERIES. If you have already sent a query and been rejected, please do not spam us or repeat the same query. It will be deleted unread.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not resend the same query after rejection or send multiple copies; following rejection, do not attempt to 'spam' the agency into reconsideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: No screenplays or scripts
rubrics_metrics.description: Do you accept screenplays? No, we do not accept screenplays or scripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Screenplays/scripts are out of scope for this agency; submit only the formats they request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Poetry not accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Do you accept Poetry? Unfortunately, we do not accept poetry at this time. The website will be updated to reflect any upcoming changes in the policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not query the agency with poetry submissions while this policy remains in effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture book queries not accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Do you accept Picture Book Queries? Unfortunately, none of our agents are accepting queries for picture books at this time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit picture book queries while agents are not accepting them; check site for future changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow-up timing and subject line
rubrics_metrics.description: How do I follow-up on a Submission? For Deborah, Jane and Heather: if you followed all the submission instructions and have not heard back within 6 weeks, please write to us with subject line 'query follow-up.' For Penelope: if you followed all the submission instructions and have not heard back within 12 weeks, please write to her with the subject line 'query follow-up.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only use the follow-up protocol after the specified wait period (6 or 12 weeks depending on agent) and only if you followed submission instructions; use the exact subject line indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: What sample material may be included
rubrics_metrics.description: Should I include any sample material besides sample chapters? If you feel that we would benefit from any relevant articles, features, newspaper clippings etc., please feel free to include them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors may include relevant articles or clippings in addition to sample chapters when they believe it benefits the submission. However, the agency cautions about other media and attachments (see other rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not send audio/visual media or unsupported formats
rubrics_metrics.description: DO NOT SEND VIDEOS, CD’s, DVD’s or other audio/visual material as we will not be able to open it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid sending CDs, DVDs, videos, or other audio/visual media; the agency cannot open these formats and such materials will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachments and hyperlinks warning (ambiguous phrasing)
rubrics_metrics.description: And again, hyperlinks or text in the body of an email. Any attachments are deleted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guideline text is ambiguous but emphasizes that attachments are deleted; authors should avoid sending attachments and be cautious about including hyperlinks or unusual email body formats—follow the agency's explicit submission form/fields instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the FAQ and submission page resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Please read the FAQ's to get a better sense of the kind of material we accept and how to follow up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the agency FAQ and the submission page (instructions 'to the left' on the site) to understand accepted material, submission format, and follow-up procedure before querying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for solicited manuscript status only
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are inquiring about the status of a solicited manuscript only, please e-mail or please call at 212-245-1993.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only inquire about status for manuscripts that were solicited; the agency provides an email and phone number for those specific status queries.
